articles.title: Boy, 15, arrested after shooting teen with BB gun in Hamilton: police
articles.summary: A 15-year-old boy was arrested after he allegedly fired a BB gun towards another teen at the St. Charles Learning Centre in Hamilton, Ont. articles.title: Brampton park to be renamed after Kalair family
articles.summary: A park in Brampton will be renamed in honour of two long-time residents from the Kalair family. After a city council motion in August, the park’s renaming is set to take place on Oct. 16. The city will officially rename Eastbourne Park to Kalair Family Park. articles.title: Cyclist protest blocks province from removing bike lane in Etobicoke
articles.summary: Cyclists in Toronto delayed the province’s removal of the Etobicoke section of Bloor Street W. bike by rallying in a protest that prevented the scheduled construction from starting.

articles.summary: A watermain break in Scarborough has led to a sinkhole and road closure along Kennedy Road early Wednesday morning, causing traffic disruptions and TTC bus detours. articles.title: Kawhi Leonard fits right in with new Raptors teammates as Toronto romps past Knicks
articles.summary: As far as Kawhi Leonard was concerned, his first game with his new Toronto Raptors teammates felt like a seamless fit. Leonard drew the loudest cheers of the night — especially when he scored each of his game-high 21 points — in his re-debut for the Raptors as Toronto rolled past the New York Knicks 148-98 on Tuesday.

articles.title: Why 18 candidates are fighting for this Toronto council seat
articles.summary: With longtime councillor Paula Fletcher stepping down, Ward 14 (Toronto-Danforth) has drawn 18 candidates looking to claim the open seat on city council. CBC’s Dale Manucdoc breaks down the crowded battleground.

articles.title: 2 men charged days after fatal collision in Scarborough: police
articles.summary: Two men have been charged following a fatal collision in Scarborough on Sunday, police say.

articles.title: Man facing arson charge week after hundreds of Israeli flags torched at North York church: police
articles.summary: Toronto police say a man identified at a downtown Toronto protest has been charged in connection with the burning of hundreds of Israeli flags earlier this month.
